motion.name: ease-civic
motion.purpose: Ease-out-expo for fade-up and bar-grow entrances; calm, no bounce.

motion.name: fade-up
motion.purpose: Round cards and panels rise in on reveal.

motion.name: bar-grow
motion.purpose: Tally bars grow from the left, staggered 90ms.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single call to action that runs the election.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary">See what happens with my ballot</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--federal, #1b3a6b); color: #fff; padding: 0.625rem 1.25rem; border: none; border-radius: 4px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; transition: background 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--ink, #14202e); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--federal, #1b3a6b); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: var(--eliminated, #9aa6b2); cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Candidate Card (selected)
components.description: A ranked candidate: federal-wash fill, federal border, hue-coded left edge, filled rank pip.
components.css: .ds-cand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; padding: 1rem; background: var(--federal-soft, #e8eef6); border: 1px solid var(--federal, #1b3a6b); border-left: 3px solid #0e7068; border-radius: 4px; color: var(--ink, #14202e); } .ds-pip { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 2.25rem; width: 2.25rem; border-radius: 9999px; background: #0e7068; color: #fff; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-cand-name { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.375rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-swatch { height: 0.625rem; width: 0.625rem; border-radius: 2px; background: #0e7068; }

components.name: Eyebrow Label
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.625rem; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: var(--ink-soft, #51606e); }

narrative.overview: The look of a trustworthy public notice that decided to be warm instead of cold. It borrows the structural calm of official election material but strips out everything intimidating about a government form. Plain-spoken, low-density, encouraging. Color carries meaning, never decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Cool civic paper, not the warm AI cream default
One federal blue does the structural work; candidate colors are categorical, not partisan
Plain-language copy that explains jargon in place
Accessibility (AA, colorblind-aware, keyboard, reduced-motion) is a floor, not a feature

rules.name: The Neutral-By-Construction Rule
rules.body: Candidate colors are categorical, never partisan. Never map a candidate to red-vs-blue opposition or any party signal.

rules.name: The Earned Red Rule
rules.body: Flag Red appears only on validation errors. If it shows up as an accent or decoration, it's wrong.

rules.name: The No-Lift Rule
rules.body: No drop shadows on cards or panels. Separation is a border and a background shift, never elevation.

dos: Do keep candidate colors categorical and AA-verified on paper. Pair every color with a label, number, or hatch.
Do reserve federal blue as the one structural accent and flag red for errors only.
Do explain jargon in plain language right where it appears.
Do keep surfaces flat - borders and tonal shifts for separation, never shadows.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion on every animation.
donts: Don't make it look like partisan or campaign material.
Don't make it look like a bureaucratic government form.
Don't make it look like a flashy data dashboard.
Don't make it childish or gamified.
Don't introduce any color outside the locked palette in globals.css.
